DESIGN NOTES (S32K3xx data sheet; S32K3 Hardware Design Guidelines Rev E2; Node60 compute page)
GATE-MCU-01 PASSED 2026-10-28: all 257 balls and every planned function checked against NXP IOMUX (Nov 2025), IBIS and
  BSDL (257BGA); signed off by the user. Re-run for DEC-018 (8 balls) passed 2026-10-30. Re-run it if the pin plan changes. The pin table above each unit is the plan.
Supplies: VDD_HV_A = VDD_HV_B = VREFH = 3V3_MAIN, V15 = 1V5_CORE (U303), V11/V25 internal (decoupling only).
  NTC dividers are ratiometric to 3V3_MAIN = VREFH. Check the S32K3 supply ramp-rate limits against the LMQ66430
  soft start (HDG 2.10.1) during bring-up.
Clock: 16 MHz crystal on FXOSC (DEC-015), core and peripherals via PLL; CMU monitors FXOSC. Unused GPIOs
  unconnected (disabled), as NXP HDG Rev E2 Table 33 requires. RESET_B pulled up to VDD_HV_A (4.7k on p3), as Table 33 requires.
Watchdog: internal SWT, hard-locked after start-up (DEC-005). Clock monitor CMU -> reset.
RESET_B (PTA5) on RESET_L: TPS3702 window supervisor (p3) wired-OR, PHY RESET_N, debug header pin 10.
Flash IS25LP032D-JNLA3 on LPSPI2, mode 0 or 3, own CS with 10k pull-up so it is deselected through reset;
  WP and HOLD pulled up (single-IO SPI). Powered from switched 3V3_MAIN; log flush before PHY sleep (DEC-007).
Debug: Cortex 10-pin (project default). Pin 7 is the key, pin 8 unused. SWDIO 10k up, SWCLK 10k down.
Default states: all port pins are disabled inputs out of reset; LPSPI3/4/5 PCS0 and LPSPI2 PCS0 are held high by
  each switch's internal pull-up and R4xx respectively; FLT and IRQ lines idle high via their pull-ups.

DESIGN VALUES (LMQ66430-Q1 SNVSBV1F; TPS62850x-Q1 SLUSDM0N; TPS3702-Q1 SBVS261C; Node60 DEC-004, DEC-006, DEC-026). Values per D-45.
Power-up order (DEC-004): VDDAU_AON always on -> LAN8670 INH high -> U302 3V3_MAIN -> 3V3_MAIN > 2.45-2.7 V
  -> U303 1V5_CORE (U303 runs from 3V3_MAIN since DEC-026). VDDA <= VDDAU + 0.5 V holds because VDDAU is up first. No FS26, latch or MCU gate.
0R debug links (project default: every regulator output): R on each *_REG -> rail, 0603 rated 2 A.
  Feedback senses the regulator side, so opening the link leaves the regulator in regulation.
U302 3V3_MAIN: LMQ66430MC3 fixed 3.3 V (VOUT/FB on the output), 2.2 MHz, MODE/SYNC = GND (auto PFM/PWM).
  TI Table 8-4: L 2.2uH, COUT >= 40 uF effective -> 2 x 22uF 10V 1210 + 100nF; CIN 2 x 4.7uF 100V + 100nF 100V
  (100 V = >= 2x the 34 V OV cut-off). CVCC 1uF. BOOT: internal 0.1 uF (TI: CBOOT DNP), so no-connect. PG unused.
U303 1V5_CORE (DEC-026): TPS628502QDRLRQ1 on 3V3_MAIN. At 3.3 V in the duty is ~45 %, far above tON,min (50 ns max).
  COMP/FSET = VIN: internal 2.25 MHz, compensation setting 2, spread spectrum on (Table 8-1; COUT >= 18 uF eff.).
  MODE/SYNC = VIN: forced PWM, so no light-load PFM pulses fall into the AM band. PG unused.
  VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + 76.8k / 51k) = 1.504 V, CFF 10 pF C0G (TI Table 9-2). L 0.56 uH (Table 9-1 lists 0.56 uH):
  dIL = 1.5 x (1 - 1.5/3.3) / (0.45 uH x 2.25 MHz) = 0.81 A pp at L -20 %. CIN 10uF 16V 1206 + 100nF (TI: 10 uF).
  COUT 3 x 22uF + 100nF (max 200 uF). Until DEC-026 an LMQ66430 on VBAT_FILT: it folded back into the AM band.
EN chain: 3V3_MAIN - 100k - 1V5_EN - 100k - GND. EN rises at 1.1 V (1.05-1.15 V), falls at 0.96-1.05 V, so EN is
  high above 2.10-2.30 V; U303's own UVLO (2.45-2.7 V rising, 2.1-2.6 V falling) sets the start and stop.
Wake timing (GATE-NET-01, accepted 2026-10-23, to be measured): OPEN Alliance limit is supply ramp + PHY init
  <= 15 ms (Sleep/Wake-Up Electrical Interface Spec v1.0 sec. 5.2); the LAN8670 "1 ms" is Microchip's allocation.
  3V3_MAIN ~2.5 ms EN delay + 2-4.6 ms soft start, LAN8670 D0 ~2 ms POR + 0.9 ms init: ~10 ms expected.
U304 TPS3702AX33, SET = GND: UV 3.10 V / OV 3.50 V (+/-6 % window, 0.55 % hysteresis, +/-0.9 %).
  The SET-high +/-2 % window (3.23 / 3.37 V) is too tight for buck transients. UV and OV open drains are
  wired-OR onto RESET_L with 4.7k to 3V3_MAIN. No internal reset delay: release timing comes from
  the S32K344 reset sequence (GATE-SUP-02).
U301 TPS7B8133QWDRVRQ1: 40 V, Iq 3.5 uA (above the 1-2 uA Rev A target). EN tied to IN (always on); DNC open;
  thermal pad to GND. COUT 2.2uF 10V 0603 (datasheet: 1-200 uF effective, ESR 1 mOhm-5 Ohm), CIN 1uF 100V.
Inductors (user choice 2026-10-23): Wurth 74438356022HT 2.2 uH (Isat 7.6 A) and 744383560056HT 0.56 uH (Isat 9.55 A; DEC-026),
  -55..+150 C. Check the 2.2 MHz core loss in Wurth REDEXPERT before release.

DESIGN VALUES (LAN8670 DS60001573K; OPEN Alliance 10BASE-T1S; Node60 DEC-007, DEC-012)
Mode straps MODE[1:0] = 10b (RMII, 50 MHz REFCLKIN): RXD3/MODE1 pulled up, RXD2/MODE0 pulled down, 10k each.
PHYAD[4:0] = 00001b: RXER/PHYAD0 up; CRSDV/PHYAD1, RXD0/PHYAD2, RXD1/PHYAD3, CRS/PHYAD4 down (10k).
  PHYAD is a hardware strap only; the PLCA node ID is commissioned in flash (separate from PHYAD).
TXEN 10k pull-down (Microchip: prevents transmission while the MAC is in reset). MDIO 10k pull-up to VDDP.
IRQ_N open drain, 10k pull-up to 3V3_MAIN -> T1S_IRQ_L to the MCU (PHY ready after cold boot).
INH: P-channel open drain to VDDAU with 10k pull-down (Microchip ref.), drives the 3V3_MAIN buck EN and the
  LM74910H SLEEP pin directly (DEC-004). No FS26, latch or MCU gate.
RESET_N on RESET_L (TPS3702 window supervisor + S32K344 RESET_B): every MCU reset also resets the PHY,
  so straps are re-latched and firmware always re-initializes from a known state.
WAKE_IN unused (no local wake, DEC-007) -> VSS per datasheet. TXD2/TXD3 unused in RMII (internal pull-downs).
TXER/ACMA unused -> VSS. TXCLK/RXPI, COL, RXCLK/WAKE_OUT, GPIO0, XTO unused: no-connect.
RBIAS 12.4k 1 % (Microchip reference).
Decoupling: 10nF + 100nF at every VDDP/VDDA/VDDAU pin, 10uF bulk on VDDP and VDDA (Microchip sec. 6).
  10nF goes closest to its pin. Ferrite beads in the reference are optional and not fitted.
Line interface (DEC-012 rev. C, Microchip AN1718), layout order connector -> ESD -> termination -> DC block -> CMC -> PHY:
  C DC block 2 x 100nF C0G 100 V (OPEN Alliance: >= 50 V). FL501 ACT1210E-241 (240 uH, 10BASE-T1S rated).
  D ESD 4 x VETH100A1DD1 (<= 2 pF/line each): D501/D502 at J903, D503/D504 at J912 (DEC-012 rev. C, D16-2).
  Keep the pair symmetric through the CMC.
  Capacitance budget: CMDI <= 25 pF: PHY 8.5 + CMC 10 + ESD 2 x 1.0 (two pairs) leaves ~4.5 pF for connectors + traces.
  Termination: OA split network switched by latching relay K501 (DEC-017), box below right.
50 MHz clock: Y501 ECS-3225SMVQ, enable tied high (runs with 3V3_MAIN). One output, two 33R series resistors,
  one to PHY XTI/REFCLKIN, one to the MCU RMII REF_CLK. Length-match both traces (Microchip layout note).
OPEN: TDK has not published a CMC class for ACT1210E-241 (DEC-012 risk). VETH100A1DD1 24 V working voltage
  vs a 24 V short to battery on the bus: see DEC-012.
Switched bus termination and relay driver (K501, Q501-Q502, R516-R522, C514)

DEC-017 (OPEN Alliance 10BASE-T1S impl. spec 6.4.1; Microchip AN1718 rev D). Relay holds its state with no power.
SET (pin 1 +, pin 8 -) = END NODE: COM-SET closed, 49.9R 1 % legs (R517, R519) -> 100R across the pair.
RESET (factory state) = DROP NODE: COM-RST closed, 1.5k legs (R516, R518) = common-mode termination.
Centre tap: C514 100nF 100V || R520 100k to GND. Contact resistance 100 mOhm max (0.2 % of a leg).
Drive: T1S_TERM_END high >= 10 ms -> Q501 pulls pin 8 low -> SET. T1S_TERM_DROP high -> Q502 pulls pin 1 low -> RESET.
  Never both high. Idle: both low (R521/R522), both coil ends at 3V3_MAIN, no current. Coil 64R, 46.6 mA.
Firmware: state stored in flash, restored with one 10 ms pulse at every cold boot (DEC-017).
LAYOUT: K501 and legs in line on the pair next to the ESD, short symmetric stubs; no ground pour around them.
T1S ESD at J912 (D503-D504)

since either connector may face the harness. D501/D502 go at J903's pins,
D503/D504 at J912's, each right at its connector (DEC-012 rev. C).
